items.title_en: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition
items.title_zh: 英伟达宣布首席执行官交接
items.summary_en: NVIDIA announced a transition involving its chief executive officer. The announcement concerns a change in the company’s top leadership.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达宣布首席执行官将进行交接。此次公告涉及公司最高管理层的变动。

items.title_en: Anthropic IPO
items.title_zh: Anthropic 筹备首次公开募股
items.summary_en: Anthropic has filed to become a public company and published a founders’ letter along with related information. The company is organized as a public benefit corporation focused on securing AI’s benefits and mitigating its risks. It says AI could accelerate scientific innovation, increase economic growth, help cure major diseases, and address long-standing problems if managed well.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 已提交申请，准备成为一家上市公司，并公布了创始人公开信及相关信息。该公司采用公益公司架构，致力于发挥人工智能的益处并降低其风险。Anthropic 表示，如果得到妥善管理，人工智能可能加速科学创新、提高经济增长率、推动重大疾病治疗，并解决长期未能解决的问题。

items.title_en: Abandoned Quake 4 expansion finished by modders and now playable
items.title_zh: 被放弃的《Quake 4》扩展包由模组作者完成并已可游玩
items.summary_en: The never-released Quake 4 expansion is now playable through openQ4 0.14.1, the Awakening Edition. The free, open-source replacement engine includes a second campaign, stable shadow mapping, a rebuilt interface, Vulkan support on Windows, smarter bots, and an experimental Android app. It also supports the original campaign and multiplayer on current Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck systems.
items.summary_zh: 从未正式发行的《Quake 4》扩展包如今可通过 openQ4 0.14.1“觉醒版”游玩。这款免费开源的替代引擎加入了第二战役、稳定的阴影映射、重制界面、Windows Vulkan 支持、更智能的机器人以及实验性的 Android 应用。它还支持在当前的 Windows、Linux 和 Steam Deck 系统上运行原版战役和多人模式。

items.title_en: Why Writing Correct Software Is Hard
items.title_zh: 为什么编写正确的软件如此困难
items.summary_en: The essay examines the relationship between programs and correctness, asking why writing correct software must be hard. It draws on computability and complexity theory to argue that programs and the complete understanding required to establish their correctness are fundamentally at odds. The piece expands on a talk about computational complexity in software verification and includes additional proofs and results.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨程序与正确性之间的关系，并追问为什么编写正确的软件必然困难。文章借助可计算性理论和复杂性理论，论证程序与验证其正确性所需的完整理解在根本上存在冲突。内容扩展自一场关于软件验证中计算复杂性的演讲，并加入了更多证明和研究结果。

items.title_en: Talking Zen 6 with Mike Clark at AMD In-Depth
items.title_zh: 在 AMD 深度访谈中与 Mike Clark 谈 Zen 6
items.summary_en: The item is an interview with AMD’s Mike Clark about the Zen 6 architecture. The available text provides no further technical details.
items.summary_zh: 该内容是围绕 Zen 6 架构对 AMD Mike Clark 的访谈。现有文字未提供更多技术细节。

items.title_en: Our software engineering interviews are changing (a little)
items.title_zh: 我们的软件工程师面试正在改变（幅度不大）
items.summary_en: Jane Street says the way it conducts software engineering interviews is changing slightly as LLMs reshape software development. Most of its engineers now use LLMs daily for writing, reading, debugging, and reviewing code, as well as for non-coding tasks. The company has also described its AI development practices and how agentic coding is changing its workflows.
items.summary_zh: Jane Street 表示，随着大语言模型改变软件开发方式，其软件工程师面试也在进行小幅调整。该公司大多数工程师如今每天使用大语言模型来编写、阅读、调试和审查代码，也用于许多非编码工作。公司还介绍了自身的 AI 开发实践，以及代理式编程如何改变工作流程。

items.title_en: PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, 14.25, and 19 RC 2 Released
items.summary_en: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group released updates for PostgreSQL 18, 17, 16, 15, and 14, along with the second release candidate of PostgreSQL 19. The releases fix 52 security vulnerabilities and more than 140 bugs reported in recent months. Some post-update steps may be required, and the project documents them in its updating guidance.
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 全球开发组发布了 PostgreSQL 18、17、16、15 和 14 的更新，以及 PostgreSQL 19 的第二个候选版本。这些版本修复了过去数月报告的 52 个安全漏洞和 140 多个错误。更新后可能需要执行额外步骤，项目已在升级指南中说明相关要求。

items.title_en: AWS emulator
items.title_zh: AWS 模拟器
items.summary_en: AWS Emulator is presented as a project related to emulating AWS services. The available context does not provide further technical details about its implementation or supported services.
items.summary_zh: AWS Emulator 是一个用于模拟 AWS 服务的项目。现有信息没有提供其实现方式或所支持服务的更多技术细节。

items.title_en: Libreagi – Save OSS Models
items.title_zh: LibreAGI：保存开源模型
items.summary_en: LibreAGI is a private BitTorrent tracker where members preserve copies of open models that may disappear from their original hosting locations. The project argues that open models should outlive the services that host them. It provides torrent-based tooling for sharing model copies.
items.summary_zh: LibreAGI 是一个私有 BitTorrent Tracker，成员可保存那些可能从原托管位置消失的开源模型副本。该项目认为，开源模型的存续时间不应受限于托管它们的服务。项目提供了基于种子文件共享模型副本的工具。

items.title_en: United Airlines bans AI agents from booking flights on behalf of travelers
items.title_zh: 联合航空禁止 AI 代理代旅客预订航班
items.summary_en: United Airlines said it is banning AI agents from making flight reservations on behalf of travelers. The airline cited security risks and the possibility that such actions could violate federal rules. Consumers are increasingly using agents such as Meta’s Muse and OpenAI’s dots for tasks including shopping and purchases.
items.summary_zh: 联合航空表示，将禁止 AI 代理代旅客预订航班。该航空公司称，这类操作存在安全风险，并可能违反联邦法规。消费者正越来越多地使用 Meta 的 Muse 和 OpenAI 的 dots 等代理来完成商品研究、比价和购买等任务。

items.title_en: 93% of paint splatters are valid Perl programs (2019)
items.title_zh: 93% 的颜料飞溅都是有效的 Perl 程序（2019）
items.summary_en: A paper investigates whether it is possible to smear paint on a wall without producing a valid Perl program. Its stated result is that 93% of paint splatters are valid Perl programs, accompanied by a gallery of the resulting programs. The work presents the question as a long-standing open problem in programming languages.
items.summary_zh: 一篇论文研究了这样的问题：把颜料涂抹到墙上时，是否可能不生成有效的 Perl 程序。论文给出的结果是，93% 的颜料飞溅都属于有效 Perl 程序，并配有这些程序的展示画廊。作者把这个问题称为编程语言领域长期存在的开放问题。

items.title_en: My AI agents found an unmapped Maya site?
items.title_zh: 我的 AI 代理发现了一个未标记的玛雅遗址？
items.summary_en: AI agents analyzed NASA lidar data and identified a Maya site beneath the jungle in Mexico. The site had already been mapped by archaeologists and described in Estrada-Belli et al. 2025, but it was not yet listed in Mexico’s official INAH register. The agents therefore rediscovered the site rather than discovering it, and the process took less than 72 hours to reach an official response from the Mexican government.
items.summary_zh: AI 代理分析 NASA 的激光雷达数据，在墨西哥丛林下识别出一处玛雅遗址。考古学家其实已经绘制过该遗址的地图，并在 Estrada-Belli 等人 2025 年的论文中记录了它，只是它尚未列入墨西哥国家人类学与历史研究所（INAH）的官方名录。因此，代理完成的是“重新发现”而非发现；从提出想法到收到墨西哥政府的正式回复耗时不到 72 小时。

items.title_en: Tim Peters has died
items.title_zh: Tim Peters 去世
items.summary_en: Tim Peters has died. He was a figure associated with Python, but no further details are available here.
items.summary_zh: Tim Peters 已去世。他是与 Python 相关的重要人物，但现有信息未提供更多细节。

items.title_en: Critical RCE Vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server
items.title_zh: Apache HTTP Server 存在严重远程代码执行漏洞
items.summary_en: CVE-2026-119618 is a critical race-condition vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server’s HTTP/2 module, mod_http2. The flaw affects the assign_headers() function when it handles shared resources, and a remote unauthenticated attacker could use it to corrupt heap memory and execute arbitrary code. Wiz reports that 64% of cloud environments have vulnerable resources; no public exploit or in-the-wild exploitation had been reported at publication time.
items.summary_zh: CVE-2026-119618 是 Apache HTTP Server HTTP/2 模块 mod_http2 中一个严重的竞态条件漏洞。该漏洞出现在 assign_headers() 函数处理共享资源时，未经身份验证的远程攻击者可能借此破坏堆内存并执行任意代码。Wiz 报告称，64% 的云环境存在易受攻击的资源；截至发布时，尚无公开漏洞利用程序或野外攻击报告。

items.title_en: Researchers discover rare star system that emits radio signals every 8 minutes
items.title_zh: 研究人员发现每 8 分钟发出一次无线电信号的罕见星系系统
items.summary_en: Scientists at the Curtin University node of ICRAR linked mysterious radio pulses to a pair of stars known as GPM J071507−114153. The system contains a white dwarf and a G-type star similar to the Sun, orbiting each other. The white dwarf spins once every eight minutes, providing the unusual timing associated with the signals.
items.summary_zh: 国际射电天文学研究中心科廷大学节点的科学家将神秘无线电脉冲与名为 GPM J071507−114153 的双星系统联系起来。该系统由一颗白矮星和一颗类似太阳的 G 型恒星组成，两者相互绕行。白矮星每 8 分钟自转一周，这与信号出现的特殊周期相对应。

items.title_en: Gemini Decisions API
items.title_zh: Gemini Decisions API
items.summary_en: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API, powered by its Gemini Decision 1 model. It can evaluate up to 1,000 yes/no, multiple-choice, or rubric-scored questions in a single pass across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs. Google describes the decisions as fast and calibrated for its applications.
items.summary_zh: Google 发布了由 Gemini Decision 1 模型驱动的 Gemini Decisions API。它可以在一次处理中，针对文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF，评估最多 1,000 个是非题、选择题或按评分标准判定的问题。Google 将其描述为速度快且经过校准的决策 API。

items.title_en: Electric Ship Batteries Promise Compact, Cooler Power
items.title_zh: 电动船舶电池有望实现更紧凑、更低温的供电
items.summary_en: Immersion-cooled electric-ship batteries place battery cells directly in a liquid coolant to reduce the risk of thermal runaway. Xing Mobility says its Immersio CTP system substantially improves energy density compared with conventionally cooled marine batteries. Denser packs could reduce battery-room size and increase available cargo capacity.
items.summary_zh: 浸没式冷却电动船舶电池将电芯直接置于液体冷却剂中，以降低热失控风险。Xing Mobility 表示，其 Immersio CTP 系统相比传统海事电池冷却方式可显著提升能量密度。更高密度的电池组有望缩小电池舱并增加可用货运空间。

items.title_en: A false smoke alarm almost drowned Jane Street's only NYC datacenter
items.title_zh: 一次误报的烟雾警报差点淹没 Jane Street 在纽约唯一的数据中心
items.summary_en: A Jane Street systems-team account describes a false smoke alarm at the firm’s only New York datacenter. The facility lost cooling, and staff rushed to unplug every power cord before the sprinkler system activated. The incident is presented as an example of the hands-on work required when a serious infrastructure failure nearly occurred.
items.summary_zh: Jane Street 系统团队的一篇回忆讲述了该公司纽约唯一数据中心发生误报烟雾警报的经过。机房一度失去冷却，员工赶在喷淋系统启动前冲进去拔掉所有电源线。这个事件展示了基础设施险些发生严重故障时，系统团队必须亲自处理现场问题。

items.title_en: Lock Your GitHub Actions
items.title_zh: 锁定你的 GitHub Actions
items.summary_en: GitHub Actions now supports workflow lockfiles. Previously, users were advised to pin actions to a full Git commit SHA because tags can be changed and redirected to malicious code in supply-chain attacks. Lockfiles provide another mechanism for constraining the actions used by a workflow.
items.summary_zh: GitHub Actions 现在支持工作流锁定文件。此前，建议用户将 action 固定到完整的 Git 提交 SHA，因为标签可以被修改，攻击者可能借此在供应链攻击中将原本安全的标签指向恶意代码。锁定文件为限制工作流所使用的 actions 提供了另一种机制。

items.title_en: Jensen Huang Was the Face of the A.I. Boom Powering the U.S. Economy
items.title_zh: Jensen Huang 曾是推动美国经济的 AI 热潮代言人
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang was unusually central to NVIDIA’s success and served as a rhetorical and financial booster for investments driving economic growth. NVIDIA has also been unusually central to the AI boom, developing chips used by many AI models and helping finance data-center construction. The report argues that Huang’s removal could therefore have broader macroeconomic implications.
items.summary_zh: Jensen Huang 在英伟达的成功中扮演了异常核心的角色，也是推动经济增长的相关投资在舆论和资金层面的重要推动者。英伟达同样在 AI 热潮中占据异常重要的位置，不仅开发了许多 AI 模型使用的芯片，还帮助为数据中心建设提供资金。报道因此认为，黄仁勋离任可能产生更广泛的宏观经济影响。

items.title_en: Emacs in the Age of Magic
items.title_zh: 魔法时代的 Emacs
items.summary_en: Emacs in the Age of Magic considers Emacs in the context suggested by its title. No further reliable details are available.
items.summary_zh: 《魔法时代的 Emacs》围绕标题所指的主题讨论 Emacs。现有信息没有提供更多可靠细节。

items.title_en: I'm Working on a FOSS Linux Pinbal Simulation Engine
items.title_zh: 我正在开发一款 FOSS Linux 弹球模拟引擎
items.summary_en: The developer is adding features, fixing bugs, and improving performance in a Linux pinball simulation engine. The engine is intended to be fully free and open-source software, but it needs more work before an initial release. The developer plans to demonstrate it at the 2026 IAAPA Expo to gauge vendors’ interest in supporting Linux and FOSS.
items.summary_zh: 开发者正在为一款 Linux 弹球模拟引擎增加功能、修复错误并提升性能。该引擎计划完全采用自由开源软件许可，但在首次发布前仍需进一步完善。开发者计划在 2026 年 IAAPA Expo 上展示它，以了解厂商对支持 Linux 和 FOSS 的兴趣。

items.title_en: Hyper-realistic sand with WebGL2
items.title_zh: 使用 WebGL2 实现超逼真的沙子模拟
items.summary_en: This browser-based sand simulator uses WebGL2 and JavaScript to model moving grains. Users can draw and push the sand, tilt a phone to slide the grains, or shake the device to scatter them. It supports touch and motion controls on phones and tablets, as well as desktop browsers.
items.summary_zh: 这款浏览器沙子模拟器使用 WebGL2 和 JavaScript 模拟沙粒运动。用户可以绘制并推动沙子，在手机上倾斜设备让沙粒滑动，或摇晃设备将其散开。它支持手机和平板上的触控与动作控制，也可在桌面浏览器中运行。

items.title_en: The CFPB says it's looking out for consumers. Data tells a different story
items.title_zh: CFPB 称其正在保护消费者，但数据却呈现出另一番景象
items.summary_en: Complaints about banks and other financial companies continue to rise while officials appointed by Donald Trump suppress enforcement actions at the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau. The report was supported and co-published by the Economic Hardship Reporting Project.
items.summary_zh: 针对银行及其他金融公司的投诉持续增加，而唐纳德·特朗普任命的官员正在压制消费者金融保护局的执法行动。该报道获得 Economic Hardship Reporting Project 的支持并联合发布。

items.title_en: 30 years of Internet transfers with curl
items.title_zh: curl 互联网传输 30 年
items.summary_en: On November 11, 1996, Brazilian student Rafael Sagula posted the source code for httpget 0.1, a roughly 100-line C program for downloading files over HTTP. The early tool had few error checks and limited functionality, but it became the starting point for the project’s later history. The author recalls discovering the code shortly after its release, before Google was widely used.
items.summary_zh: 1996 年 11 月 11 日，巴西学生 Rafael Sagula 发布了 httpget 0.1 的源代码，这是一个约 100 行的 C 语言 HTTP 下载工具。这个早期工具几乎没有错误检查，功能也很有限，但成为该项目后来发展历程的起点。作者回忆说，自己在代码发布几天后就发现了它，当时 Google 还未普及。

items.title_en: Show HN: Yogurt – Free, private, open-source alternative to Granola
items.title_zh: Show HN：Yogurt——免费、私密的开源 Granola 替代品
items.summary_en: Yogurt is a free, MIT-licensed desktop app that uses on-device AI models to transcribe, summarize, and chat about meetings. It runs in the background without joining calls, and keeps transcripts, recordings, and summaries on the user’s computer. The app also offers calendar integration and a local MCP server for optionally sharing notes with external frontier models.
items.summary_zh: Yogurt 是一款采用 MIT 许可证的免费桌面应用，使用设备本地的 AI 模型转录会议、生成摘要并进行问答。它在后台运行，不会加入通话，会议转录、录音和摘要也不会离开用户的电脑。该应用还提供日历集成和本地 MCP 服务器，用户可以选择通过它将笔记分享给外部前沿模型。

items.title_en: ExcalidrawZ: Local Native Excalidraw on macOS/iOS
items.title_zh: ExcalidrawZ：macOS/iOS 原生本地版 Excalidraw
items.summary_en: ExcalidrawZ is a macOS and iOS drawing app built with SwiftUI that preserves the familiar Excalidraw canvas. It adds native document management, iCloud sync, history, export, AI assistance, MCP integration, and other Apple-platform features. Drawings are handled as application documents rather than loose browser downloads.
items.summary_zh: ExcalidrawZ 是一款使用 SwiftUI 构建的 macOS 和 iOS 绘图应用，保留了熟悉的 Excalidraw 画布。它增加了原生文件管理、iCloud 同步、历史记录、导出、AI 辅助、MCP 集成及其他 Apple 平台功能。绘图会作为应用文档管理，而不是浏览器中零散下载的文件。

items.title_en: Faster Retrieval for Better, More Efficient RAG
items.title_zh: 更快的检索带来更好、更高效的 RAG
items.summary_en: The work focuses on maximum inner product search, a core operation in recommendation systems, search, and retrieval-augmented generation. Given a query vector, MIPS searches millions of candidate key vectors for the best match, whose associated data is then used to answer the query. In RAG systems, that data is typically a relevant document prefixed to the prompt.
items.summary_zh: 这项工作关注最大内积搜索（MIPS），它是推荐系统、搜索和检索增强生成的核心操作。MIPS 根据查询向量，在数百万个候选键向量中寻找最佳匹配，再使用与之关联的数据处理查询。在 RAG 系统中，这些数据通常是被添加到提示词前的相关文档。

items.title_en: Using voltage glitching to unleash the A100 in my mining card
items.title_zh: 通过电压故障注入解锁挖矿卡中的 A100
items.summary_en: A voltage fault-injection vulnerability in the GA100 die can reportedly blow arbitrary fuses on an NVIDIA CMP 170HX. The author used it to turn an 8GB CMP 170HX into a card functionally similar to an A100-80G, enabling roughly 120–126 functional SMs instead of the 108 used in production A100s. The method can also unlock features including NVLink, PCIe Gen4, NVJPG, NVDEC, and MIG, although several of those features were not specifically tested.
items.summary_zh: 据称，GA100 芯片中的电压故障注入漏洞可以烧断任意熔丝。作者利用这一点，将一张 8GB 的 NVIDIA CMP 170HX 改造成在功能上类似 A100-80G 的显卡，并启用了约 120 至 126 个可用 SM，而量产 A100 使用的是 108 个。该方法还可以解锁 NVLink、PCIe Gen4、NVJPG、NVDEC 和 MIG 等功能，但其中几项尚未经过专门测试。

items.title_en: The Utah Teapot
items.title_zh: 犹他茶壶
items.summary_en: The Utah Teapot is presented as the subject of this item. The available context contains only a video reference and no further description.
items.summary_zh: 该条目以“犹他茶壶”为主题。现有信息只有一个视频引用，没有提供更多描述。

items.title_en: A general purpose Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs
items.title_zh: 面向 x86-64 PC 的通用 Apple Silicon 层
items.summary_en: Stela is a UEFI boot program intended to provide an Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs. It includes an Arm64-to-x86-64 translator, an NVIDIA Metal driver, and a model of Apple silicon hardware, and can currently boot macOS and most apps. The v0.1.0 release is slow, requires more testing, and has a low chance of booting on current hardware.
items.summary_zh: Stela 是一个面向 x86-64 PC、旨在提供 Apple Silicon 兼容层的 UEFI 启动程序。它包含 Arm64 到 x86-64 的转换器、NVIDIA Metal 驱动以及 Apple 芯片硬件模型，目前可以启动 macOS 和大多数应用。v0.1.0 运行速度较慢，仍需大量测试，在当前硬件上成功启动的概率也很低。

items.title_en: The Confidential Payments Meta and TikTok Made to Addicted Teens
items.title_zh: Meta 和 TikTok 向成瘾青少年支付的秘密款项
items.summary_en: The report examines confidential payments made by Meta and TikTok to settle lawsuits involving social-media addiction among teenagers. No further details are available.
items.summary_zh: 报道调查了 Meta 和 TikTok 为解决涉及青少年社交媒体成瘾的诉讼而支付的保密款项。现有信息未提供更多细节。

items.title_en: Fitting Four 32 GB Resizable Bars Behind a PCIe Switch on Linux
items.title_zh: 在 Linux 上让 PCIe 交换机后方容纳四个 32 GB 可调整大小的 BAR
items.summary_en: Linux 7.0 allocated a PCIe switch bridge window that was too small for four 32 GB GPU BARs, preventing assignment. A kernel module that pads the BARs fixes the issue. The system places four AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700s and two RTX 3090s behind a Broadcom PEX88096 switch, allowing peer-to-peer transfers without routing through the CPU.
items.summary_zh: Linux 7.0 为 PCIe 交换机分配的桥接窗口不足以容纳四个 32 GB GPU BAR，导致设备无法分配。一个用于填充 BAR 的内核模块可以修复这一问题。该系统通过 Broadcom PEX88096 交换机连接四张 AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 和两张 RTX 3090，并允许显卡之间绕过 CPU 进行点对点传输。

items.title_en: Socratic Tutor
items.title_zh: 苏格拉底式导师
items.summary_en: The Socratic Tutor is an agent skill designed to guide users toward genuine mastery through questions that make them reason, predict, and explain rather than simply listen to a lecture. It is intended for ongoing teaching sessions, not one-off factual questions. When the user’s intent is ambiguous, it first asks whether they want a quick answer or a full tutoring session.
items.summary_zh: “苏格拉底式导师”是一项代理技能，通过要求用户推理、预测和解释来帮助其真正掌握知识，而不是单纯进行讲授。它适用于持续的教学过程，不适用于一次性的事实问答。当用户意图不明确时，它会先询问用户想要快速答案还是完整的辅导过程。

items.title_en: ExecuTorch WebGPU: PyTorch Models on the GPU, in the Browser
items.title_zh: ExecuTorch WebGPU：在浏览器中通过 GPU 运行 PyTorch 模型
items.summary_en: ExecuTorch now runs PyTorch models on browser GPUs through WebGPU without converting them to another framework’s format. Models are exported with torch.export to an ExecuTorch .pte file and can run on WebGPU-enabled desktop, laptop, and mobile browsers. Browser inference keeps prompts, inputs, and outputs on the device, while also enabling offline use and reducing server-side inference costs.
items.summary_zh: ExecuTorch 现在可以通过 WebGPU 在浏览器 GPU 上运行 PyTorch 模型，无需转换为其他框架的格式。模型通过 torch.export 导出为 ExecuTorch 的 .pte 文件，可在支持 WebGPU 的桌面、笔记本和移动浏览器中运行。浏览器端推理可将提示词、输入和输出保留在设备上，同时支持离线使用并降低服务器端推理成本。

items.title_en: I'm making LLMs work on small and old devices
items.title_zh: 让大语言模型运行在小型和老旧设备上
items.summary_en: smolmaxxing explores how to run the largest practical language models on small or old devices such as TV boxes, phones, single-board computers, and routers. It uses custom kernels, memory optimization, and weight streaming, with claims measured on the actual hardware. On a Xiaomi TV Box S 3rd Gen with about 1 GB of usable RAM, the project reports running models ranging from 260K to 16B parameters.
items.summary_zh: smolmaxxing 探索如何在电视盒子、旧手机、单板计算机和路由器等小型或老旧设备上运行实际可用的最大语言模型。项目使用定制内核、内存优化和权重流式传输，并在真实硬件上测量各项结果。在可用内存约 1 GB 的 Xiaomi TV Box S 第三代上，项目报告称可运行参数量从 26 万到 160 亿不等的模型。

items.summary_en: AI Red Lines asks people to write down what developments in AI would make them act and what actions they would take. It encourages users to decide and share those thresholds before they face a real situation.

items.title_en: Running web sites makes me not want to
items.title_zh: 运营网站让我不想再运营了
items.summary_en: The writer says that operating self-hosted websites has become discouraging because LLM scrapers generate heavy traffic. After testing anti-scraping tools, the writer observed traffic from numerous cloud-provider IP ranges, including Meta, Azure, and Alibaba, saturating the site’s upload capacity with generated content. The experience led the writer to remove the mitigation tool and reconsider self-hosting.
items.summary_zh: 作者表示，由于大语言模型爬虫制造了大量流量，运营自托管网站变得令人沮丧。在测试反爬工具后，作者观察到来自多个云服务商 IP 段的流量，包括 Meta、Azure 和阿里巴巴，这些流量用生成内容占满了网站的上行带宽。这样的经历促使作者移除缓解工具，并重新考虑是否继续自托管。

items.title_en: Roadside investigations of psyllids, ants and eucs
items.title_zh: 路边调查：木虱、蚂蚁与桉树
items.summary_en: While driving along a country highway, the writer noticed that young River Red Gums appeared to be dead or dying. These young trees, called “recruits,” were seedlings, saplings, and immature trees that had self-seeded around older parent trees. The post uses the observation as the starting point for a roadside botanical investigation.
items.summary_zh: 作者在乡间公路驾车时注意到，年轻的河红桉似乎已经死亡或正在枯死。这些被称为“更新个体”的树木，是在成年母树周围自然播种形成的幼苗、树苗和未成熟树木。文章以这一观察为起点，展开了一次路边植物调查。

items.title_en: 20 Years of Pyrolog
items.title_zh: Pyrolog 诞生 20 周年
items.summary_en: Pyrolog’s first surviving commit to the PyPy repository was made on November 12, 2006, after development had begun earlier that year. The RPython-based Prolog implementation never gained real users, but it contributed to research and influenced other RPython projects. Its development also involved implementing constraint programming in PyPy as part of an EU research project.
items.summary_zh: Pyrolog 首次保留在 PyPy 仓库中的提交发生于 2006 年 11 月 12 日，而开发工作在当年更早时候就已开始。这个基于 RPython 的 Prolog 实现从未拥有真正的用户，但推动了相关研究，并影响了其他 RPython 项目。它的开发还参与了一个欧盟研究项目中为 PyPy 实现约束编程的工作。

items.title_en: Show HN: Aircad – Professional drafting and 3D modeling in the browser
items.title_zh: Show HN：Aircad——浏览器中的专业制图与 3D 建模
items.summary_en: Aircad is a browser-based CAD system with AI integration, professional drafting and documentation tools, and NURBS-based solid modeling. It exposes a scripting API that can perform interface operations and complex modeling tasks, and supports formats including DXF, DWG, STEP, and 3DM. The creator built it to address the cost, performance, collaboration, and extensibility limitations they see in existing CAD tools.
items.summary_zh: Aircad 是一款集成 AI 的浏览器 CAD 系统，提供专业制图与文档工具以及基于 NURBS 的实体建模。它提供脚本 API，可执行界面中的操作和复杂建模任务，并支持 DXF、DWG、STEP 和 3DM 等格式。开发者打造它是为了应对现有 CAD 工具在成本、性能、协作和可扩展性方面的问题。

items.title_en: Making a €40 USB-C hub work as a Nintendo Switch 2 dock
items.title_zh: 让一款 40 欧元的 USB-C Hub 充当 Nintendo Switch 2 底座
items.summary_en: The project investigates how to make a €40 USB-C hub work as a Nintendo Switch 2 dock. The author wanted a smaller travel alternative to the official dock and used a USB-PD sniffer to examine why a generic hub normally fails. The hub is a Cable Matters 7-in-1 model with DisplayPort, HDMI, VGA, and up to 60 watts of power.
items.summary_zh: 该项目研究如何让一款 40 欧元的 USB-C Hub 充当 Nintendo Switch 2 底座。作者希望找到比官方底座更适合旅行的替代品，并使用 USB-PD 嗅探器分析普通 Hub 无法工作的原因。这款 Hub 是 Cable Matters 七合一型号，配有 DisplayPort、HDMI、VGA 接口，供电能力最高为 60 瓦。

items.title_en: Pulling the Lever in a Subway Problem
items.title_zh: 在地铁难题中拉下制动杆
items.summary_en: The author recounts pulling a subway emergency brake after seeing a passenger’s arm trapped in a closing door as the train began leaving the station. Other passengers were shouting for someone to pull the brake, but no one acted, and the author feared the person would lose his hand. After the train stopped, the passenger pulled his arm inside, with his bag still outside.
items.summary_zh: 作者回忆说，地铁驶离车站时，一名乘客的手臂被正在关闭的车门夹住，于是他拉下了紧急制动杆。其他乘客也在呼喊拉闸，但无人采取行动，作者担心那名乘客会失去手掌。列车停下后，乘客把手臂拉回车内，但包仍留在车外。
